Magic: The Gathering Streets of New Capenna Bundle | 8 Set Boosters + Accessories
KEY PRODUCT FEATURES
• 8 Streets of New Capenna MTG Set Boosters
• 1 foil alt-art promo card
• 40 basic land cards (20 foil + 20 nonfoil)
• Spindown life counter + card storage box
• Join one of five powerful families and build your criminal empire

DESCRIPTION
The Streets of New Capenna Bundle contains 8 Streets of New Capenna Set Boosters—the best boosters to open just for fun—plus exclusive accessories, with 40 basic lands (20 traditional foils and 20 nonfoils), 1 traditional foil promo card with Bundle-exclusive alternate art, 1 oversized Spindown life counter, 1 card storage box, and 2 reference cards.

Each Set Booster contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token, ad card, counter punchout card, or special card from Magic's history (a card from "The List"). In every pack you’ll find a combination of 1–4 card(s) of rarity Rare or higher and 3–7 Uncommon, 3–7 Common, and 1 Land cards, including a guaranteed foil card.
